method: Matched viewport/DPR, same routes/setup/load/tide and environment; warmed60rAF idle sample plus full instrumented active crossing intervals. Full diagnostic geometry copies and video are overhead. Different move pace changes sample length. Mixed software measurements are not hardware performance or automatic attribution.

recording.method: Uninterrupted actual full interface at natural runtime speed; no timing override unless named. Silent Playwright original; at least2.25saftereachdocking. Setup also recorded. No cuts,slowdown or state injection.
